info.title: Re-Main
info.synopsis: La storia vede come protagonista Minato, un ragazzo che ha smesso di giocare a pallanuoto a causa di un incidente nell'inverno del suo terzo anno di scuola media. Riprende lo sport con un nuovo club quando inizia il liceo, ma la squadra, alle prime armi, incontra molti problemi...

episodes.title: "Mi scusi, lei chi è?"
episodes.synopsis: "Minato Kiyomizu si sveglia dal coma in seguito a un incidente stradale. Anche se una volta era una star della pallanuoto alle medie, ha perso tre anni interi di ricordi. Abbandonando ogni speranza di giocare di nuovo, entra al liceo Yamanami con un intero anno di ritardo".

tmdb.title: "Mi scusi, lei chi è?"

episodes.title: "Non sono un genio".
episodes.synopsis: "Minato viene informato da Kawakubo Chinu di una promessa che il suo io passato le aveva fatto. Quando decide di unirsi al club di pallanuoto per realizzarlo, Eitaro Oka, che ha seguito Minato a Yamanami, e Jo Jojima, il capitano del club di pallanuoto, sono felicissimi. Usano subito Minato per promuovere il club e riunire gli studenti, ma ......."

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Takekazu Ejiri, Yutaka Babayaro Inomata, and Yoshiharu Ushimado join the club, but it needs one last person to make seven for a regulation team. They ask Shugo Amihama, who swam in junior high, but he refuses. When they persist, Shugo makes a proposal.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Amihama stubbornly refuses to join, but a certain something changes his mind and Yamanami's Water Polo Club is officially underway. Despite the team struggling with the basics, they find themselves playing their first practice match.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: Amihama stubbornly refuses to join, but a certain something changes his mind and Yamanami's Water Polo Club is officially underway. Despite the team struggling with the basics, they find themselves playing their first practice match.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Though they're only up against a junior team, the club learns just how intense water polo, aka "water wrestling," can be. Minato's spirits are crushed by his own uselessness, but that night, Eitaro pays a visit and reveals a big secret he's been hiding.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Hoping for their first win at the summer prefectural tournament, the club holds a training camp during Golden Week. The team is getting along and there are good vibes all around, but all the while, something weighs on Ushimado's mind.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Hoping for their first win at the summer prefectural tournament, the club holds a training camp during Golden Week. The team is getting along and there are good vibes all around, but all the while, something weighs on Ushimado's mind.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Jo, the water polo captain, proposes that the team creates an original jersey. But emotionally attached to his own, Amihama declines saying, "I don't need a jersey."

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: While watching a video, Minato sees his past self from before he lost his memories. When asked about it, Chinu reveals her motives for keeping quiet about the truth. After hearing what she says, Minato is shocked beyond words.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Eitaro tries to persuade Minato to rejoin the water polo club. Wanting no part of it, Minato is frustrated at being compared to his past self and his failure to become Shogakukan's ace.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: With one month left till the prefectural tournament, Minato directs the others on how they should train while starting a regimen of his own to work on getting his groove back. He and the team have a lot on their minds as the days dwindle down.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The Yamanami water polo club nervously faces the day of the prefectural tournament. Minato spearheads the team as they battle Rikka Gakuen in the first match, but their opponents have come up with a strategy to keep Yamanami from going on the attack.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: It's finally time for their second match of prefecturals--the long-awaited showdown with Shogakukan. Minato, Eitaro, Jo, Amihama, Ejiri, Babayaro, and Ushimado join their seven hearts as one and challenge the best team in Japan.
